fnol_text: My name is Ines Nguyen-Tran and I live at 583 Hawthorn Street, Dover, DE 19937. You can reach me on (555) 254-1898 or ines.nguyentran@example.com. Heavy rain all afternoon on 15 August 2024. Water pooled on the lawn and then came into the lounge at floor level. Carpets and the sofa are soaked. Policy HH-2023-00089. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Nguyen-Tran on (555) 254-1898 to acknowledge the claim. Ines confirmed the loss date as 15 August 2024.
Site visit to 583 Hawthorn Street. Neighbour Sofia Pereira was present and confirmed the timeline.
Ines sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
